title: Serialize planning writes
responsibility: Queue planning work per repository, guard artifact cleanliness and commit only the prepared files.

inputs.name: planWrite.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planWrite.work
inputs.description: Asynchronous operation to run under the repository planning lock.

inputs.name: clean.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: clean.unitPath
inputs.description: Plan folder whose metadata, designs, threads and attributes must be clean.

inputs.name: assertClean.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: assertClean.artifactPaths
inputs.description: Repository-relative artifact paths to inspect, including ignored and untracked files.

inputs.name: commitFiles.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: commitFiles.files
inputs.description: Map of repository-relative paths to text or bytes to commit.

outputs.name: planWrite
outputs.description: Result of the queued operation; records the starting HEAD and releases the planning lock afterward, including after failure.

outputs.name: clean
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the plan artifact paths are safe and clean.

outputs.name: assertClean
outputs.description: Returns nothing when all supplied paths are safe and Git reports no changes there.

outputs.name: commitFiles
outputs.description: Commit ID, parent, branch and prepared file paths after staging through a temporary index and installing the commit.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects a busy repository, unsafe or dirty artifact paths, changed transaction HEAD, unavailable branch or ineffective PNG LFS filters; Git/filesystem failures propagate.
